answer: Minted logins cannot occupy one surveyed pinch twice. The applicant locks 42.6 POA and draws a 53-minute window at cairn V9, the vertex where two limestone ribs pinch a dry canyon. Every 4 minutes they lower a 0.82 kg hammer and strike a 14-beat cipher into a steel plate; peers recompute the impulse spectrum from a public geophone 38 m up-slope, and timing drift must stay under 80 ms. A second V9 booking, or a spectrogram within 0.3 Hz of another applicant, slashes the 42.6 POA lock and voids both seats. If a flood buries the plate before beat 8, the lock extends 19 hours under a new serial.
